sources.title: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B on Consumer Hardware: Real VRAM Numbers, the ...
sources.snippet: TL;DR: Meta is back in open weights. Muse Glimmer 30B (released August 10, 2026, Apache 2.0) is a dense 30B multimodal model built for always-on local agents, and it's aimed squarely at the 24GB card you may already own: the official K-Quant-17GB tier loads on a used RTX 3090 or RTX 4090 with room for a 130K context. sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Dense 29.6B vision-language model with a ViT-G/14 perception encoder and 128K context, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic use. Emits channel-scoped reasoning and XML-style ATEM tool calls rather than JSON, so it needs the dedicated `muse_glimmer` tool-call and reasoning parsers.
